constants.name: wdSectionBreakContinuous
constants.description: New section without a corresponding page break.

constants.name: wdSectionBreakEvenPage
constants.description: Section break with the next section beginning on the next even-numbered page. If the section break falls on an even-numbered page, Word leaves the next odd-numbered page blank.

constants.name: wdSectionBreakOddPage
constants.description: Section break with the next section beginning on the next odd-numbered page. If the section break falls on an odd-numbered page, Word leaves the next even-numbered page blank.

constants.name: wdPageBreak
constants.description: Page break at the insertion point.

constants.name: wdColumnBreak
constants.description: Column break at the insertion point.

constants.name: wdTextWrappingBreak
constants.description: Ends the current line and forces the text to continue below a picture, table, or other item. The text continues on the next blank line that does not contain a table aligned with the left or right margin.
